reviews.text: Helpful, knowledgeable staff.
Very nice experience and competent staff. Recommended!
Real professionals.  Time to your pet and you. Deep and honest caring.

Veterinarian Paavola almost killed my 13-year-old cat.
He lacks basic knowledge. He works according to a certain formula. He put my cat to sleep without calculating the dose correctly and gave him a Nobivac injection, even though they should definitely not be given together.
My cat was very sick that night and the next day. He had diarrhea, was bleeding from his mouth, walked unsteadily, and then remained motionless all day.
We called many doctors and asked what to do.
We do not recommend this doctor at all.
We arrived at the clinic early and asked if the doctor could see us earlier because our elderly cat was very stressed. They told us to go home or wait.
We waited and asked the nurse to give the cat something to calm him down because he was screaming so loudly. But they coldly said they would not give it.

Aikaisemmat kokemukset / Previous experiences
I have been to several vets' clinics in town. Yours is the best in terms in services and communication. Your vets are human.
Very nice staff, avarage prices but vets are very expensive in Helsinki. Reachable by tram

A shamelessly inferior experience.

I speak English well, so it was no surprise that the doctor didn't speak Finnish at all. But he didn't seem to understand English either, even though I have a very light accent and I tried to speak with as simple a vocabulary as possible. He either didn't listen or understand what I was saying.

The doctor also didn't understand the effect of the sedation and couldn't find a vein, so he poked four holes until he asked a nurse to do it for him. An arrogant nurse came in and immediately after the doctor left, started spouting his own opinions about a situation he didn't even know anything about. The animal hasn't been in their care before, so he didn't have any health information about the animal, but he also had his own assumptions and possibly prejudices based on my appearance. Maybe? I don't know how else he had the guts to behave so outrageously. It takes a unique kind of sociopathy to slap someone in the face for having to euthanize their beloved animal friend. This caregiver had the nerve to criticize my decision to put the animal out of its suffering, while simultaneously injecting a lethal drug into my pet's bloodstream. In other words, unimaginably cruel behavior from someone who is specifically in the business of taking care of animals.

All in all, a very poor and horrible experience, even though the reviews say it's a good place. I don't recommend it.

From the beginning, it felt like my pet was in good hands. The doctor called after the dental examination and told me the number of teeth to be removed, the estimated cost, and asked for permission to remove the teeth. This gave me a secure feeling that I knew and could influence what was happening to the cat. The service was first-class from start to finish!
Fast and professional service! The skilled nurse took the blood samples quickly and reliably – the dog didn't even notice the entire sampling. I highly recommend! Same-day appointment.
Good and friendly service 😊 I recommend it to everyone …
Professional, good care. Epicrisis and information about the medications used are sent to your email. This is important if you visit another Ell.

Great experience. The nurses Katja and Sonja were able to remove the bandage from my dog ​​Mauno's front paw that had been in place for over a week. At other veterinary clinics, the doctors were unable to remove it. My dog ​​is quite skittish during treatment. Thank you Katja and Sonja for your great work and kindness.
We are moving back to Helsinki and will definitely use your services in the future if needed.
Thank you for the wonderful service. The cat received attentive care and even a song to calm her down. Highly recommended! Thank you Rita & Sanna!

At first I thought this was a promising place and believed the promises of answering the phone, etc. Well, advertising is advertising, it really doesn't answer. When the eye drop bottle got contaminated, there was 'no time' to call the local pharmacy for a new prescription the same day or even the next day, but had to get it on site during opening hours with the sick animal. There was no longer any contact with the doctor who treated it. At the same time, the price of the medicine increased by 1 1/2 times from just under €20 to almost €30.
A fundraising place where they don't care about the animal's aftercare, you are left alone. I have had pets for 30 years and I have never encountered such poor treatment before, even though I have dealt with animals a lot at doctors and have sometimes been very dissatisfied with what I have experienced there.
Two stars instead of one star because the staff I encountered were nice and I think we got the right diagnosis. However, convenience has only limited meaning when continuity of care and monitoring, as well as contact with the treating doctor, are practically completely absent. We had thought of this as a permanent place of care for our animals, but after this, thank you no.
I hope that the less fortunate will be helped better.

The vet has good transport connections and parking. Our cat received good and warm care, the tooth extraction went well. The home instructions were also clear for nervous owners😃. A nice surprise was the follow-up check-up that was part of the dental operation, if necessary. Very good value for money and above all, comprehensive, friendly and competent care for the pet.
I recommend.
Good job! The staff was incredibly professional and the customer was really well taken care of. I felt good and this became my new regular.

Location
Friendly service. Wonderful doctor! Good nurse. Missi didn't even flinch when the blood test was taken.
Thank you 😺
T. Missi and her family
Excellent and professional service that respects the animal. I would bring an animal here from afar for care.
Visited the clinic with our senior dog for his rabies vaccination and tapeworm treatment before a long journey. The staff were kind, professional, and friendly. Everything went smoothly.
The most wonderful place in Helsinki🥰 …
Really friendly and professional service.💗 …
Competent and lovely staff. Always good service.

Emergency care / Need for emergency care
My dog ​​had been having diarrhea for several days. The friendly, accurate and clearly caring attitude to our situation was good. The transaction in English went smoothly, and nothing was left unclear. A written report of the visit and care instructions were also sent home, which is an excellent thing! It was easy to come from the other side of the city (by public transport)!

Today we went to the dentist with Westy, and the experience was really good. A special thank you to veterinarian Vera Hakala, who was absolutely wonderful and whose professional and calm work was easy to trust. ❤️

I was especially nervous about the anesthesia beforehand, but Vera was really understanding of my concerns, listened calmly and explained everything clearly. Westy was examined carefully before the procedure, and I immediately felt that he was in good hands.

During the dental treatment, the x-rays showed problems that required treatment. I was called during the procedure, the findings were explained clearly and the treatment options were discussed with me. After the treatment, I received an even more detailed explanation of the situation and also saw the x-rays.

I especially appreciated how carefully and thoughtfully Westy's teeth were treated. I had a strong feeling that for each tooth, they thought about what was the best solution for Westy. I also received a lot of useful advice about home care and dental care in the future.

Westy is now recovering well at home and has already tasted the food. 😊

A warm thank you to Vera Hakala and the entire clinic for the good care of Westy and the friendly and caring encounter. After such an experience, it is easy to come here again. ❤️
Very good care and service
Cat at the dentist. 👍. …

⭐ 1/5

Unfortunately, my experience at Pups ’n Pets was very bad.

I originally booked an appointment for my dog ​​to have his teeth x-rayed. Before the appointment, I was informed by email of the price of the dental package, which included scaling, dental x-rays, and a dental examination. However, the email did not mention anything about the dog having to fast before the appointment or that the examination would require anesthesia.

When we arrived at the reception, I was told that the dog could not be x-rayed because he had not fasted. I was told that instructions had been sent to me by email. I checked my email and spam folder, but I could not find any such message or instructions. The clinic staff also had my correct email address.

After that, I was charged €93 for the cancelled appointment, even though I did not cancel the appointment myself and had not been clearly informed in advance about the fasting requirement.

I think that such important preparation instructions should be clearly and confidently communicated to the client in advance, especially when it is a paid procedure.

I am very disappointed with the clinic's communication and customer service.
A really good experience with sudden euthanasia for a domestic rat. Compassionate staff and reasonable prices even on a Sunday.
Competent, friendly and incredibly caring staff. You'll leave the clinic with a smile on your face.

A few months ago we needed emergency care and the place was open in the evening, so we ended up there. The experience was initially positive and we returned to the same place again to renew our pet's vaccinations. This visit was also good. Friendly staff, professional and fast service, but at a leisurely pace.
The dog was examined very thoroughly.
We were able to get an appointment quickly in an acute situation. The service was expert, empathetic, and unhurried, exactly what we wanted in that situation.

It was ok at best. Took the dog to get neutered. The one male member of staff was quite dismissive when asking a question. The female was very kind and nice. We were told a price over the phone, yet got there and the total bill was 150€ over what we'd be told what it'd cost. A bit of a killer when you have a large family.

Absolutely wonderful place! I brought my dog ​​to the appointment because of his limping and both the animal caretaker and the veterinarian were empathetic and professional. The whole time I had the feeling that they knew what they were doing and that they were not doing “unnecessary” tests on the dog just for the sake of money. The premises were really clean and we could park our car right next to it. In addition, we received the necessary medicine when paying, and we didn't have to go to the pharmacy separately. I definitely recommend this place to everyone.

The dog's teeth cleaning itself went normally, but otherwise it didn't leave such a good taste in my mouth: the facilities were really small and cramped, and the dog was put in a muzzle after the first anesthetic shot, and it was still in the muzzle when they picked up our dog from lying alone on the floor of the reception room. On the other hand, I understand the precautions, but other vets have not been this strict before, especially since our dog is not the biting type and hates muzzles.

I visited here a while ago but haven't posted a review.
I've been here many times with my dog ​​Adi, good service and reasonable prices.

I sent price estimates for fine needle aspiration and other necessary tests (skin changes and lumps on the dog) to various places asking how much the tests would cost, the price estimate was HALF less than what Eviden** had asked for the same set. (approx. €800/€400)
The Savio veterinary clinic was also affordable but there was some test they couldn't do there.

In addition to the incredible fact that the timid wolfhound was well taken into account in every way,
the treatment was good and the service was friendly, the bill didn't even come close to the price estimate but was lower. This left a clinic where I haven't used any other places since the first visit.

I really appreciate that pups and pets helps low-income pet owners and makes visits free of charge if someone needs it.
Compared to other vet stations, it felt like there was more time, less rush.

Thank you! Highly recommended.

Highly recommended! Here, animals are treated with consideration for their needs, and even a fearful dog gets the welcome it deserves. The owner is listened to and even difficult situations are always handled with great sensitivity.
Pleasant service and competitive prices made me a regular customer.
Good and relatively affordable dental clinic.
Best service and I will definitely go again.

I found a loose tooth on my dog ​​and the first appointment at pups n pets was about 3 weeks away. However, we were called the next day and offered a cancellation period of about a week. We were leaving for a rental cottage at that time, so I made the appointment, but said I would come back soon and confirm it as soon as I had sorted out the expenses. However, I was called back again and the lovely customer service representative told me that she would still get us an earlier appointment, 2 days later, saying “you wouldn’t need to move the cottage then” 🩷.

Thank you, absolutely great service and I got my dog ​​treated quickly, which was the most important thing.

In addition, I have nothing but positive things to say about the dental treatment itself. They called after the x-rays to see what needed to be done and gave a price estimate. All 12 teeth had to be removed and they tried to do this at once. However, my dog’s blood pressure had slowly started to drop towards the end of the anesthesia. They called about this too and said that they didn't want to prolong the anesthesia and 2 would be left for the next time to be removed.
All of this made me feel safe and knew that my dog ​​was in good hands, where the dog's well-being comes first.
The vet and the nurse treated our dog in a wonderful way🩷
I will continue to visit you for other matters as well.
Thank you!
The best service and care!

Previous experiences
The wonderful doctor Anni Nyrhinen took the dog who was afraid of the doctor into consideration and everything was done on the dog's terms. She also knew how to take the owner into consideration. A wonderful encounter! Thank you very much!

I own two cats, who are population cats by origin. Despite the cats' timidity, veterinarian Jenni got the check-ups and vaccinations done professionally and calmly. The staff, including the service desk in the lobby, are really friendly and helpful. The pricing is also reasonable. For this reason, I am not considering other options for a veterinary clinic for my cats.

Very friendly person and our dog really enjoyed the vet's company 👅, we only went for routine vaccinations, the experience was stress-free and a very considerate, animal-friendly doctor, job well done …
The euthanasia of our dog Nina was handled calmly and thoughtfully by the entire clinic staff.
Wonderful customer service and professional staff. The dog (and owner) were treated on their terms, both at the vet and during the visit. Highly recommended!
Professional staff
Good service and good prices!
The visit itself went great, Elle was lovely but forgot to call about the blood test results. After a couple of follow-up calls, another doctor took care of it. Thank you for that❤️
I have been satisfied with the service we have received. I especially appreciate Pups 'n Pets' pro bono work for the underprivileged. The prices have been reasonable and the location is good.
Expert treatment. I can recommend Lee!!
Friendly and careful veterinary check-up.

I do not recommend this place. The final price was more than double what was originally agreed. My dog ​​had a big bruise and trauma on his tongue. He couldn't even stand up when we got home from the clinic. He wasn't used to pee outside with it. I was also told that the dog had eaten a 195 gram can of food at the clinic, even though he couldn't even drink water because the clinic made him look like a complete zombie.
The dog went to the clinic in better shape than he came out of it. We didn't get any feeding instructions afterwards or proper explanations about the use of medication. And on top of that, when I dared to tell about my experience, we were sent to animal protection, which would have practically taken the dog to euthanasia.
Now, three days later in home care, the dog has light in his eyes again and the trauma to his tongue is almost healed. In any case – avoid this place! Pups and pets- in Lääksaari
Always the same good care. Skilled veterinarians and nurses 😊 …
Great customer service and wonderful doctors!
I highly recommend
Friendly staff, good location and competitive prices.
Good location, easy to find, friendly and knowledgeable service. I think it's affordable for dental care. I recommend it 🐾 🩷🐾 …
Always excellent care and service and excellent value for money. Thank you 🧡 …
Good reception service, fast and professional approach, good facilities, good prices, close to my home, quick access to the reception, good doctors, all the necessary equipment, the job gets done.

Recommendation from family or friends
Taking care of the euthanasia of my cat Peppi so professionally and sensitively is comforting and leaves a good memory. When giving up a beloved pet was not easy in any way! Thank you again! ❤️Great doctor's work 🙏 …

Very disappointed with the care of my cat and the really rude and unprofessional customer service. I would not recommend this Kalasatama clinic to anyone!
Communication with the clinic was lacking and I was not told the real status of my cat, I was shocked when I finally saw my cat.
Eventually my cat was in intensive care in an oxygen tank at Viikki Animal Hospital for 24 hours due to complications from a dental operation.
Excellent, professional, customer service!
Highly recommended.
Quick access to the reception and first-class expert care service for your pet!
Really friendly service.
Our dog Kiira received very good care at the dental clinic. The teeth were extracted and the dog is doing well. Clear, good communication between the staff and the care. Highly recommended.
Competent staff and good service ☺️
Good and safe service. Friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Wonderful, knowledgeable and really friendly staff. I recommend 🩷 …
The dog had a dignified end to his life, thanks to doctor Rita and nurse Sanna.
Professional and friendly service! My recommendation. +++++
Warm and attentive caregivers and doctors who make you feel like your pet is the most important thing in the world.
10/10 in every way! Thank you.

We have been going here with our rescue dog for a few years, and we are very satisfied every time, both with the customer service, the meeting between the owner and the dog, and the fair pricing. The pro bono work is also important and very much appreciated, thank you for that 🩷 …

We went here with my dog, but unfortunately I think we got a wrong diagnosis and expensive treatment that didn't help. The experience was not good and I can't recommend this clinic.
I would have liked more professionalism and more thorough examination.
Friendly staff, all animals are taken care of. Good care.

In addition to the dog's visit to the vet, I needed an urgent doctor's appointment, which was arranged at the same time, without having to miss the procedure and book a new appointment. A big recommendation for the warm and friendly service.

Wonderful doctor. Friendly and professional. Explained all the procedures well and also listened to our wishes. We received good care for our elderly patient and also clear follow-up care instructions.

Warm and professional ell Viivi.
Reasonable prices compared to many others. Maya isovilla thanks for the help!
Absolutely amazing place and professional doctor
Friendly and professional service. Comprehensive services, including specialists available.
Friendly, knowledgeable and unhurried service. Appointment was on time and there was no rush.

We were able to easily agree on several procedures for one visit and get a transparent price estimate for the whole thing via Whatsapp. The clinic employees were really helpful and transparent throughout the process as we tried to find answers to our questions. Dental treatment and bone X-rays were performed during the same visit and we were also positively surprised by the final price of the procedure, which was at least reasonable, as well as the veterinarian's proactive communication even after the procedure regarding further investigations. Veterinarian Jenni was incredibly customer and patient-oriented and friendly, the best I have ever visited. Thank you!
Kind and expertise service for your pet! Always a pleasure to visit here.
absolutely wonderful customer service with euthanasia
Really good service and professional staff!

Always excellent service at a reasonable price compared to others we've been to. Enough time is allocated for the visit and each procedure is not billed separately (e.g. the nails were kindly trimmed during the sedation). You get the feeling that both the dog and the person are being met. Thank you 🙏💜

Both dogs had to be seen within a month. The procedures included sedation and a nail operation for one and a blood test and urine sample for the other. So the bill for both was under €300. At another place years ago, a blood test and ultrasound cost around €500.
Always good and friendly service and appointments are always available even with short notice.
Very friendly and warm service. Price and quality are right in my opinion.
We went here for our dog's nail injury. We received really friendly, attentive and professional service.

Professional caring staff.
The English speaking vet was absolutely top notch and understanding.
Made my dog's euthanasia a peaceful moment.
Highly recommend the clinic ❤️

A trusted place where you can feel safe taking your pet for treatment❤️ Always a friendly welcome, professional service and good care. The prices are also cheaper than many other veterinary clinics where I took my cats before I found Pups’n Pets. The service here is much better than at previous clinics.

The best dentist for our little dog, the first time I wasn't nervous at all about leaving the little one under anesthesia, the doctor creates such a good customer experience with professionalism and empathy. Thank you for the good care 🎀 …
Great and empathetic staff

I used to like the clinic until the following very bad experience. My dog's dental treatment was almost twice as expensive as I had expected based on the treatment packages and preliminary information. No euro price estimate was given in advance, and I was not told that the costs could increase so significantly, even though the station called during the operation.

After the treatment, I tried to clarify the matter with the clinic management, but no responsibility was taken and nothing was seen as unclear or fixable in their operations. The responsibility was completely transferred to the customer, which seemed unreasonable, since the price list on the internet was not correct.

I have heard rumors about the clinic doing pro bono work, which is great and appreciable. However, this experience unfortunately left me with the feeling that this may be financed at the expense of our other paying customers.

I would not have chosen this clinic if I had known that I could not trust the costs and price estimates on the website. My dog ​​has a good vet who also does dental work elsewhere, and we will continue to go there in the future, even though it is a longer distance. I cannot recommend this clinic to anyone who wants clear, fair pricing and if responsible and good customer service are important.

Expert and warm service with respect for the animal. An otherwise busy evening at the clinic did not affect the quality of our care or service. We were listened to and our concerns were taken seriously. I can warmly recommend Pups ’n Pets!
Good service
Very good vet.

The nurses were really friendly and lovely. The vet treated the dog well, but they had missed out on customer service lessons. After the treatment, I asked if I could renew the prescription for the medication I was constantly taking, and I was told that these things would be taken care of in advance, not at this stage when the animal is handed over, but he is now looking into it. Then I couldn't find any information on the computer about the prescription that they had originally prescribed and had already renewed once, so I didn't renew it. The previous times were nice doctors and the continuation

All the spaces were very clean. The staff was friendly, and *most importantly* my dog was treated very well. The prices were also completely reasonable. + Easy to reach location.

I rarely give out five stars (or reviews at all), but this vet station fully and wholeheartedly deserved it. 5/5.
Expert staff and great service. Special thanks for the flexible payment methods, which made my family's situation much easier.

Friendly, cheerful and knowledgeable reception. We received a diagnosis and medication quickly, it's also nice that while waiting you can easily go out for a walk sometimes -- a good thing with a big dog. Prices very reasonable.
Great service and affordable prices, and no extra push like some places 😍 …

Of course, I could mention the "usual" things: a good location for us (Jätkäsaari) right around the corner, reasonable pricing and friendly service + of course, the fact that the cat got the help it needed. But...Pups and Pets stands out above all because it shares my values. I find it important that I can support an operator with my own choice that also helps those in need through pro bono activities.

Excellent and professional service. A stress-free and safe environment for your pet by a knowledgeable doctor. There was no robbery at the checkout either, the costs were more than reasonable considering the very comprehensive treatment and medication. Definitely recommended!

You pay for a vet consultation and you deal with the vet from start to finish. Very qualified doctors who pay close attention to each case. A peaceful place and friendly service. The price level is more moderate than at many other veterinary clinics in the Helsinki metropolitan area.
Friendly staff. Competent doctor. Close to home
My dogs have always received high-quality and professional care at your place. Special thanks to the empathetic and friendly staff. We will continue to come :)
Warm, professional service and good care for your pet. Prompt communication and answers to questions. Good location and easy access by public transport or your own car. Reasonable prices.

Pimu's first visit to Pups'n Pets was exactly what we wanted from a visit to the vet. Based on the information we provided when booking the appointment, our concerns were addressed in advance. The examinations were done without any rush and with constant clarification for us. Good advice on home care and nice instructions to contact us if there was even the slightest problem. The next day we had to ask small clarifying questions by message and we received answers quickly. We think the pricing is also quite reasonable.
From now on, "A regular".

Thanks Stefan and Jenni!
Appreciative service, reliable, knowledgeable veterinarians who are passionate about their work. Excellent.
Great service and very quick
Always a great service!
It was such friendly service, Yuki was definitely excited!
Excellent and professional service!
A truly wonderful, empathetic and pleasant experience. My cat was really calm even though he is usually shy about doctor visits. The premises are clean and peaceful.
I got an appointment for my cat quickly and the care was first class. A nice little clinic where my pet was given individual and calm attention.

Very friendly, professional & lovely people. A fantastic vet with amazing opening hours (evenings, weekends, public holidays - it’s so important to be open at such times, thank you!). Highly recommended :)
Unreliable service, we received no information about the treatment in advance, except for "the doctor will take a look around". The staff was both unfriendly and uncertain.

The entire staff is friendly!
Expert, friendly doctor, got all the vaccinations done at once.
Customer service continues after years, thank you!
We have had wonderful staff and excellent service every time for a couple of years!
My rescue has always received heartfelt service.
An amazing place my cat was very unwell and he got surgery straight after his x-ray

We went to the dental clinic in Jätkäsaari and I was really satisfied. I was impressed that both before and after the dental treatment, the veterinarian had time to talk and listen. I felt that I and my wishes were listened to.
We will definitely come here again!
Always professional and knowledgeable service and nice staff. Thank you! ❤️

I have been to PupsPets several times and the experience has always been excellent. The staff is very friendly, knowledgeable and genuinely interested in the well-being of the animal. The tests and procedures are always explained clearly, making the visit safe and stress-free.
An empathetic and compassionate veterinary clinic. They treated our guinea pig's examinations and euthanasia with empathy and professionalism. I highly recommend them.

Warm and caring service. I received help in an emergency. It's great that the company is taking on social responsibility by helping low-income pet families. A family business and the participation of family members in the clinic's work is important to me.

Paju the cat has been here several times and Paju has always liked her doctor Jenni. Always had good service and communication. Because of her regular medication, getting a new prescription is always easy. I have recommended pups n pets to many of my friends and acquaintances. They also had the same great experience.
Merry Christmas from Paju and me. 🥰
The best place
Excellent vets and nurses. Competitive prices. Our dog is happy to visit Pups'n pets each time :-)
Good service

It has been two years since our beloved 21-year-old cat Oona was brought to you, the cat was unwell and dying. You had completely overbooked the day and the cat waited and vomited in its cage and you left it alone in the freezer on top of the box while we waited in the waiting room, overwhelmed with grief. This kind of behavior is completely unforgivable, the fact that the owners used to have a clinic almost next door to each other, the level was completely different. Oona has died and I have been thinking about my own experiences with veterinarians in Spain where they really cared, unfortunately this did not impress you this last time. We were just a walking bag of money to you whose problem was treated with the left hand without caring about anything.
Nice and professional experience. Pet and owner were taken into consideration 😊 …

A nice and peaceful clinic. The excellent veterinarian Jenni K. is knowledgeable and clearly follows the research in the field. She calmed our old cat down skillfully, there was no need to be afraid of sedation. The cat was not even scared of the blood test needle and didn't even need a separate nurse. Another plus is that the entire paw was not shaved bare. You can't even see the missing hairs. Everything was discussed calmly with time. Really professional atmosphere and even the cat was left wondering after previous traumas, if it could be this nice at the vet!😸
Fast and friendly service!

Thanks to the clinic and Dr. Garcia Correia Rita for the high-quality check-up and treatment of my cat. I’m very happy with the service, everything is clear and transparent, and they treat animals with care and attention.

My visit here was really disappointing. The vet seemed uncertain, the diagnosis changed several times and the explanations didn't really make sense. The conversation left me feeling bad because I didn't get any concrete answers to my dog's situation. In addition, the visit felt more like a money grab than a genuine desire to help the pet and the owner.

The appointment was for 30 minutes, but in practice we were ushered out after 15 minutes, which meant I didn't have time to ask any other questions about my dog. Elsewhere, I have been able to talk and ask questions in peace, which has been really valuable.

In addition, the advertised campaign "outpatient clinic fee 0 €" was misleading because it practically didn't reduce the costs at all - other fees raised the price to normal. It felt like customers were being lured in with a campaign, but in reality it is of no use.

The experience left me feeling bad and feeling that I and my dog ​​were ignored. I hope that in the future this clinic will focus more on openness, customer orientation, and treating every pet and owner with genuine respect.

The wonderful vet, who calmly examined my dog, really considered the options from many angles. However, together we decided on euthanasia right on the first visit. A difficult decision, but the doctor's empathy and the gentle treatment of both the owner and my dog ​​made it easier. I am really grateful that this is the vet we ended up with in this situation. There was no rush during the whole time. When I left, I noticed that there were people waiting in line waiting for their turn. I hope they had enough understanding. Thank you for accompanying Russe on her final journey ❤️
Finally, a truly versatile and knowledgeable veterinarian
Appointment late by 30 minutes, was compensated a little and staff were nice.
We have used the services of many veterinary clinics, but about 2 years ago we found this gem. Very good service and nice staff. Reasonable prices for a veterinarian.

Very good customer service and easy to book and get an appointment 🙂 I only found this place this year and even though there are vets closer, I'm happy to make the extra trip when I know the service is good! …
Great service
Super friendly and professional service, I've been visiting this place with my dog ever since he was a puppy.
Brought my cat and kitten in for separate issues. Veterinarian Marco was so calm and helpful.

We have used it several times. Close by, but even more important -> the best vet in Helsinki that we have used over the years and years.. Fair pricing, genuinely dog-friendly team at work. I recommend it, 5/5 in every respect
Very friendly and professional service. I'm happy to bring my dog ​​here to be looked after, and the reception is wonderfully warm.

Professional and friendly staff. The dog received good care for the problem he needed. Pups 'n Pets Jätkäsaari.
I recommend!

We were incredibly lucky to find this wonderful veterinary clinic in Helsinki. Not only does the team speak excellent English, but they also create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that truly feels like home.

The care and kindness they showed to our gentle giant — our beloved Cane Corso, Binx — was truly heartwarming.

We visited for a vaccination against kennel cough, and Dr. Liina took her time to carefully examine our other dog, JarJar, as well. We felt genuine care and attention from the whole team, which means the world to us.

Thank you for making both our dog— and us — feel so supported and safe. Highly recommended!

Lovely staff and warm and professional service. I recommend.
Pictured is Roci thanking us for our last trip ♥️
